newsitem.title: USA: Mossimo sees Q3 sales up but EPS lower.
newsitem.headline: Mossimo sees Q3 sales up but EPS lower.

text.p: Mossimo Inc said on Monday it expects disappointing third quarter earnings but an increase in sales of more than 40 percent.
It forecast earnings of $0.14 to $0.16 a share, compared to $0.21 a year earlier, based on about 17 percent more shares outstanding.
Analysts' published expectations for the third quarter are $0.24 to $0.28 a share, the company said.
The lower earnings estimates follow unusually high production costs that hurt gross margins for men's and women's autumn sportswear collections, the company said.
Mossimo said higher production costs will also affect its fourth quarter, but will have a "substantially less" impact on earnings compared to the third quarter.
Mossimo is a designer of men's and women's activewear. It completed its initial public offering in February 1996.

"In the midst of our explosive growth, we have set in motion a number of measures that we believe will result in more rigorous and effective cost containment, including additions to our management team and new oversight policies," said Mossimo Giannulli, chairman and chief executive officer.

"While we are disappointed by the impact of higher costs experienced thus far in the third quarter, the company's fundamentals continue to be strong as evidenced by the significant customer demand for Mossimo products."
